part.text:
Fixed `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go` so repeated `client_ip`/`remote_ip` directives are merged across all Caddyfile segments instead of only the first line.

Validated:
- `go build ./...` passes.
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile` tests pass.
- Full Caddyfile adaptation merges all `client_ip` ranges inside `not`.

`modules/caddyhttp` tests could not run because the container cannot download `go-spew`/`testify` from the Go proxy (network timeout).
